reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a cryptocurrency arbitrage bot and personal trading signals as a viewer-facing financial benefit delivered through Telegram. It directs interested viewers to Telegram communities to access the offering, while displaying trading projections, percentage-based alerts, and an invitation for free custom alerts.

citations.quote: 24/7 Bitcoin & Cripto Arbitrage Bot sending signal via Telegram!
Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?
If you want to get in touch with us, feel free to join our telegram international community here:

opening.argument: Judge the limits of the claim actually made. The description says the bot monitors spreads across exchanges and offers personal signals for free; it does not promise that a signal will be profitable or that a trade will succeed. A spread alert is information about a possible opportunity, not a guaranteed return. The chart and alerts likewise do not establish that anyone executed a trade or received a payout. That uncertainty matters when deciding whether this is deceptive solicitation rather than a description of a monitoring tool.

citations.quote: Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited title and description establish a bot, signals, and an invitation to a community. They do not establish a guaranteed return, a required payment, or a claim that the displayed percentages were realized profits. The chart and alerts show information presented to viewers, not the outcome of trading on it. The prosecution's reading turns a potential use of the signals into a promise the cited material does not make.

citations.quote: 24/7 Bitcoin & Cripto Arbitrage Bot sending signal via Telegram!
If you want to get in touch with us, feel free to join our telegram international community here:

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An explicit profit guarantee is not necessary to identify the promotional mechanism. The title markets a round-the-clock arbitrage bot sending signals, while the description invites viewers to obtain personal arbitrage signals through Telegram. The alerts and trading chart reinforce that viewer-facing trading proposition. The absence of a documented payout limits what can be said about results; it does not turn the offer into a neutral risk warning.

citations.quote: 24/7 Bitcoin & Cripto Arbitrage Bot sending signal via Telegram!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?

opening.argument: The visible material supports reading this as a demonstration of an information tool. A trading chart appears beside Telegram alert messages, letting viewers inspect the kind of market data the bot displays. The description explains its operational function as monitoring exchange spreads across digital assets. Showing alerts alongside a chart can illustrate how the tool works without demonstrating a purchase, an executed trade, or a realized return. The central subject can therefore be the technology and its output, even though viewers are also told where to find it.

citations.quote: Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the alerts and chart as proof of solicitation, but those same visuals are a direct way to show what an alert interface contains. The description's monitoring language supplies an operational explanation, not evidence that the bot trades for viewers. The Telegram invitation shows that the tool is accessible; it does not by itself show that the video claims successful financial outcomes.

citations.quote: Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
If you want to get in touch with us, feel free to join our telegram international community here:

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The interface may demonstrate the tool, but the surrounding text makes the demonstration promotional. The title advertises arbitrage signals delivered through Telegram, and the description asks whether viewers want personal signals and provides a bot link. Those invitations are part of the video's message, not incidental background to an operational lesson. No completed trade need be shown for the material to promote a trading-signal workflow.

citations.quote: 24/7 Bitcoin & Cripto Arbitrage Bot sending signal via Telegram!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free? :robot: https://t.me/bitwhistlebot

opening.argument: This can be evaluated as promotion of a free information service rather than a scheme to obtain viewers' funds. The description identifies a spread-monitoring bot, names supported exchanges, and offers personal signals for free. It also invites people into Telegram communities. None of those cited claims asks viewers to deposit cryptocurrency, provide credentials, recruit others, or buy a contract. The displayed chart and alerts do not show money changing hands. Promotion alone does not establish the missing transaction or deception.

citations.quote: Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!
Supported Exchanges: Bittrex, Poloniex, Bitfinex, Kraken, Cryptopia, Gdax, Hitbtc, TheRockTrading, Liqui, Bitgrail, Binance ...more on request!
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly identifies a Telegram invitation and trading alerts, but neither cited point supplies a deposit request, credential request, or completed transfer. Calling the signals a viewer-facing financial benefit does not establish that the creator promises to generate returns for the viewer. The narrower reading is that the video promotes access to an alert service whose performance is not established here.

citations.quote: If you want to get in touch with us, feel free to join our telegram international community here:
Want to have your personal arbitrage signals for free?

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing deposit or credential request limits the claims one can make about how viewers might lose money; it does not erase the trading proposition actually promoted. The title offers a continuously running arbitrage signal bot, and the description routes viewers to personal signals through Telegram. Alongside the displayed alerts, that is more specific than ordinary promotion of a general-purpose service. The evidence supports a trading-signal solicitation without proving a completed transaction or realized return.
